rating_fields.lesson_relation_quality: 0 not linked / 1 juxtaposition or vague link / 2 explicit, correct and useful relationship
rating_fields.condition_adherence: 0 condition not followed / 1 condition followed: conceptual cases test meanings or distinctions; operational cases use a concrete source-grounded application scenario
rating_fields.lesson_kc_coverage: list of KC IDs correctly and substantively addressed in lesson
rating_fields.qcm_kc_coverage: list of KC IDs actually needed or substantively tested, supported by explanation
rating_fields.qcm_multi_kc_reasoning: 0 question solvable from one KC; 1 combines facts from at least two distinct KCs in a necessary reasoning step
rating_fields.qcm_necessity_ablations: for every KC removal: sufficient_without_kc true/false/uncertain; all-KC necessity only if every removal fails, and no smaller subset suffices
rating_fields.pdf_grounding: 0/1 for claims and answer being supported by provided texts, with source pages

judge_instruction: Do not infer necessity from kc_ids, namedrops, topical relevance or shared factual overlaps. Check possibility of solving from each strict subset using only supplied source. Mark uncertain if underdetermined; no certification without expert review.
